name: Anchor-based Parameter Interpolation with Gating
definition: A method to interpolate parameters for members present at both neighboring anchors and gate the contribution of entering members based on normalized progress t.
summary: Anchor-based Parameter Interpolation with Gating enables smooth, continuous budget decoding in 3D Gaussian Splatting by using power-law exponents for non-linear parameter mixing and opacity gating, distinguishing it from standard linear interpolation.
